title: Membership in the low-degree junta Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a set of coordinates, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinates outside $P$, represented in the corresponding restriction dimension. Then $S$ belongs to the low-degree Fourier family for that restriction if and only if $|S|\\le\\lfloor 3k/4\\rfloor$.
hypotheses_covered: Set $S$ in the restriction dimension determined by coordinates outside $P$
